chapter_summary: Gu Suizhou undergoes a painful, recurring medical procedure (pheromone drainage) administered by Xu Zhong to manage his 'madness' caused by an Alpha-Omega physiological mismatch. Gu Suizhou investigates Shen Feizhi, discovering evidence that links him to a stock market manipulation, and begins to suspect Shen Feizhi is far more capable than his background suggests. During his treatment, Gu Suizhou falls into a drug-induced sleep and experiences a vivid flashback to a shuttle crash ten years ago (C1907 Shuttle), where he was rescued by a mysterious older boy on a barren planet. This memory reveals the origin of his trauma and his deep, unresolved connection to his unknown savior.
